gauge_note: g^T N g ~ 0 (2.5e-8) but N g is NOT zero (norm below). So g spans a NULL CONE direction of the indefinite form, not a kernel. The unglued Gaussian does not literally diverge along g, but the quadratic form vanishes there: exp(-kappa/2 * 0) = 1, flat direction => the DENOMINATOR integral is divergent along g regardless. Both numerator and denominator are formal.

normalization_constants.kappa_prefactor: 1/(8 pi)  from S = S_geo/(8 pi G)
normalization_constants.16pi2_origin: delta normalization convention: (2pi)^{-m/2} kappa^{m/2} with kappa=l^2/(8 pi lP^2) gives -(m/2)ln(16 pi^2) when written as m ln(l/lP)
normalization_constants.verdict: 16 pi^2 = 2pi * 8pi exactly: the constant is entirely a delta-normalization + action-normalization artifact, as the card admits. It fixes Gamma_min and l_Omega but not lstar.
